token.title: 🔑 Ithokheni ye-GitHub
token.intro: I-GitHub iphendula iimbawo ezima-60 ngewora ekhelini elingathumeli ithokheni. Umuthi opheleleko weefoki ubiza pheze ama-32, ngalokho ukuvakatjha kwesibili kuphelelwa. Ithokheni iphakamisa umkhawulo ube yi-5000 ngewora.
token.step1: Vula Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, bese ukhetha Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: i-akhawunti yakho. Expiration: nanyana ngiliphi ilanga, umuthi awutlhogi litho elihlala isikhathi eside.
token.step4: Ungathinti imvumo nanyana ngiyiphi. Imethadatha yeengcino zomphakathi ayitlhogi nanyana ngiyiphi yazo.
token.step5: Yenza, bese ukopa ubungako be-{token}. I-GitHub ibutjengisa kanye kwaphela.
token.classic: Ithokheni yakade nayo iyasebenza: yenza yinye ngaphandle kokukhetha ubukhulu nanyana bumbi. Ubukhulu obungenalitho busafunda idatha yomphakathi ngesantya sokuqinisekiswa.
token.stays: Ihlala kule bhrawuza ngaphasi kwesihluthulelo {key} begodu iya ku-{host} kwaphela. Ayikho nanini itlolwa ebhareni lekheli, ngalokho ilinki oyabelanako iphatha umbono hayi ubufakazi. Ikunupu engaphasi kwesikhala iyisula godu kanye nekhetjhi.
token.persistHow: Faka ithokheni efayilini {env} yeseva ebamba ikhasi leli, eceleni kwe-{port}:
token.proxy: bese uyithomisa nge-{make}. Isitjhodo sibe sitlola isiqeshana se-nginx esinamathisela i-header {header} kuphrokzi {path}, ngalokho ibhrawuza ibiza umsuka wayo begodu ayikho nanini ifumana ithokheni. Isikhala lesi siyanyamalala begodu boke abavakatjhi babelana ngesabelo sinye se-5000 ngewora.
fork.refused404: Ayikho imidwa yamagatja: {message}. I-404 lapha kungaba ligatja elingekho namkha yindlela iphrokzi yeseva engayithwaliko; ithungelelwano leefoki ngaphezulu liphelele nanyana kunjani.
fork.refusedExhausted: I-GitHub iphelelwe ziimbawo eworeni le, ngalokho ayikho imidwa yamagatja ekghone ukudwetjwa. Ithungelelwano leefoki ngaphezulu liphelele. Faka ithokheni ephanelini yesihlungi, namkha ucime imidwa yamagatja ephanelini yobujamo ukuze usebenzise isabelo ethungelelwaneni kwaphela.
fork.refusedOther: I-GitHub iphendule nge-{status} emlandweni weekhomiti, ngalokho ayikho imidwa yamagatja ekghone ukudwetjwa. Ithungelelwano leefoki ngaphezulu liphelele.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Ithegi ayinalanga, ngalokho ezinye bezingabiza isibawo ngayinye, esingasetjenziswa sabelo esiseleko sewora.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, ifesidere yeekhomiti namathegi alayishiweko. Imidwa yeefoki emidala kunalo ibanjwe emaphethelweni wesinceleni.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Vula isigcino ukuze udwebe iindlela zeekhomiti zaso nokuhlanganiswa kwazo; i-aksi ibe seyincipha ibe ngumlando loyo.

forks.deeper.other: {n} kizo zifokwe godu; vula yinye ukuze uye ngaphasi khudlwana.

forks.leaves: akukho neyodwa kizo efokwe godu, ngalokho leli lithungelelwano loke.
forks.lazy: Chofoza isigcino ukuze utjengise amagatja waso ngaphasi kwaso ku-aksi yesikhathi efanako.
forks.exhausted: I-GitHub iphelelwe ziimbawo eworeni le. Faka ithokheni ephanelini yesihlungi ukuze uphakamise umkhawulo kusukela ku-60 ukuya ku-5000, namkha ubuye ngemva kokuthi iwora litjhugulukile.

bond.title: Imatriksi yeembopho
bond.help: Irowu ukuya ekholomini ngaphezulu, ikholomu ukuya erowini ngaphasi. Isibopho sika-0 likhasi, u-1 kuphambene nalo. Ukudlulisa ikhesa kuphambanisa isibili ngombala otjheli, ukuchofoza kusikhiya ngombala osapurupuru bekube kuchofoza okulandelako. Kufundwa kwaphela; sebenzisa i-CLI infinito bond ukuze uhlele.
